description: Apply a single geometry op (centroid, boundary, convex_hull, envelope, simplify, buffer, polygon↔points/lines, set_precision) to a column of Shapely geometries.

inputs.description: DataFrame with a Shapely geometry column (or WKT/GeoJSON strings)

outputs.description: Same DataFrame; the geometry column (or output_column) carries the result of `method`

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream DataFrame with a geometry column
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

method.description: `f'Operation to apply per row. One of: {sorted(_VALID_METHODS)}.'`
method.label: Method

geometry_column.description: Input geometry column. Accepts Shapely objects or WKT/GeoJSON strings.
geometry_column.label: Input Geometry Column

output_column.description: Output column name. Defaults to overwriting the input geometry column in place.
output_column.label: Output Column (defaults to in-place)

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps
